annotations.title: List credit packs, the monthly plans and Enterprise

description: List what SHIP sells: the credit packs (credits, the tax-inclusive price in US dollars and the price per credit), the monthly plans under `team.plans` (Starter and Scale: each its credits a month, monthly price, price per credit, which credits added on top also cost, and agents at once), the range of credits a workspace on a plan can add at once, Enterprise under `enterprise` (the minimum yearly credit commitment, the highest and lowest price per credit, and the agents at once at the minimum; contracts are sold by SHIP, not through checkout), what Free and the packs allow (`limits`), plus the trial size. The same catalog the pricing page shows.
name: list_credit_offers
